verdict.rationale: Snowflake's docs show it can query Apache Iceberg tables stored in customer-managed external cloud storage, aimed at data lakes that customers choose not to store in Snowflake. That covers the Iceberg part of the story without loading data into proprietary storage. missing for 10: evidence of querying Delta Lake tables, evidence of querying raw Parquet files in object storage in place (e.g. external tables), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can query open table formats and files in object storage — Iceberg, Delta, Parquet — without first loading them into proprietary storage

citations.quote: Apache Iceberg™ tables for Snowflake combine the performance and query semantics of typical Snowflake tables with external cloud storage that you manage.
They are ideal for existing data lakes that you cannot, or choose not to, store in Snowflake.
Access Apache Iceberg™ tables with an external engine through Snowflake Horizon Catalog
